title: GenLayerTransactionLifecycle
description: Protocol transaction lifecycle state only (CLAUDE.md Section 9.1). This is NOT DecisionOutcome/DecisionStage and NOT execution result - a transaction can reach a consensus-final lifecycle state while execution failed (Section 9.4/CF-005, G0-verified live). Status strings are taken from real G0 evidence: 'Accepted' (in-flight/pending finality) and 'Finalized · Accepted' (observed via `genlayer receipt`, release-evidence/r1/g0/deploy-success-pinned/smoke-deployment-receipt.txt).
